name: Yukichi Fukuzawa
description: Yukichi Fukuzawa is the president of the Armed Detective Agency and a highly skilled swordsman. Calm, disciplined, and deeply protective of his subordinates, he provides the steady leadership that holds the Agency together.

name: Akiko Yosano
description: Akiko Yosano is the Armed Detective Agency's physician and one of its most formidable members. Confident and sharp-tongued, she uses her rare healing ability to save allies from otherwise fatal injuries while carrying the scars of her wartime past.

name: Atsushi Nakajima
description: Atsushi Nakajima is a young detective who can transform into a powerful white tiger. After years of abuse at an orphanage, he struggles with his self-worth but gradually learns to use his compassion and strength to protect others.

name: Doppo Kunikida
description: Doppo Kunikida is an idealistic detective who organizes his life around the plans written in his notebook. Serious, responsible, and easily frustrated by chaos, he nevertheless risks everything to uphold his principles and protect innocent people.

name: Jun'ichirō Tanizaki
description: Jun'ichirō Tanizaki is a member of the Armed Detective Agency whose ability creates convincing visual illusions. Usually gentle and unassuming, he becomes fiercely dangerous whenever someone threatens his younger sister Naomi.

name: Kenji Miyazawa
lightNovelDebut: The Untold Origins of the Detective Agency
description: Kenji Miyazawa is a cheerful young detective from the countryside whose immense physical strength appears when he is hungry. His sincerity, optimism, and unusual trust in others often allow him to resolve conflicts in ways his more suspicious coworkers cannot.

name: Kyōka Izumi
description: Kyōka Izumi is a former Port Mafia assassin who joins the Armed Detective Agency after being rescued from the life forced upon her. Quiet and reserved, she is determined to prove that she can use her ability, Demon Snow, to protect people rather than kill them.

name: Osamu Dazai
description: Osamu Dazai is a brilliant and unpredictable detective with the power to nullify other abilities through touch. Formerly an executive of the Port Mafia, he hides exceptional strategic insight and a troubled past beneath a playful, eccentric exterior.

name: Ranpo Edogawa
lightNovelDebut: The Untold Origins of the Detective Agency
description: Ranpo Edogawa is the Armed Detective Agency's greatest detective, capable of solving seemingly impossible cases through extraordinary observation and deduction. Although he calls his talent an ability, his brilliance is entirely his own, and his confidence is matched only by his fondness for praise and sweets.

name: Naomi Tanizaki
description: Naomi Tanizaki works as a clerk for the Armed Detective Agency while continuing her studies. Outgoing and assertive, she is especially devoted to her older brother Jun'ichirō and remains composed even when the Agency is placed in danger.

name: Kikaro Haruno
description: Kikaro Haruno is a clerk at the Armed Detective Agency who helps manage its daily operations. Though she is not a combatant, she remains dependable under pressure and supports the detectives during dangerous incidents.

name: Katai Tayama
description: Katai Tayama is a reclusive information broker and former member of the Armed Detective Agency. He prefers working from the comfort of his futon, where his ability lets him control electronic devices without touching them.

name: Ōgai Mori
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Ōgai Mori is the calculating leader of the Port Mafia and a former underground doctor. He makes decisions according to cold logic and the organization's survival, often treating people as pieces in a larger strategy.

name: Ace
description: Ace was one of the Port Mafia's executives and an ability user obsessed with wealth, status, and control. He treated his subordinates as expendable assets and believed his position made him untouchable.

name: Colonel (Port Mafia)
description: The Colonel was a former soldier who rose to the rank of Port Mafia executive. He was known as a powerful ability user and was counted among the organization's previous generation of senior leaders.

name: Chūya Nakahara
dislikes: people making comments about his height
description: Chūya Nakahara is a Port Mafia executive and a master of gravity manipulation. Proud, hot-tempered, and intensely loyal, he combines exceptional martial skill with overwhelming power and shares a notoriously hostile history with his former partner, Osamu Dazai.

name: Kōyō Ozaki
description: Kōyō Ozaki is a senior Port Mafia executive who fights through the sword-wielding ability Golden Demon. Elegant and composed, she is deeply protective of Kyōka and believes that people raised in darkness cannot easily escape it.

name: Paul Verlaine
japaneseName: ポール・ヴェルレエヌ
description: Paul Verlaine is a powerful gravity manipulator, assassin, and former European spy whose origins are closely tied to Chūya Nakahara. After the events of the Arahabaki project, he becomes one of the Port Mafia's most dangerous and secluded figures.

name: Arthur Rimbaud
japaneseName: アルチュール・ランボー
description: Arthur Rimbaud was a European spy and ability user who infiltrated Japan during a mission connected to Arahabaki. Thoughtful yet driven by his lost memories, his story is inseparable from Paul Verlaine and Chūya Nakahara's origins.

name: Albatross
description: Albatross was a member of the Port Mafia's Flags who was responsible for controlling the organization's transportation and vehicles.

name: Doc
description: Doc was a member of the Port Mafia's Flags and a doctor who served as the organization's medical supervisor.

name: Iceman
description: Iceman was a member of the Port Mafia's Flags and a hit man.

name: Lippmann
description: Lippmann was a member of the Port Mafia's Flags and was in charge of public relations in the Mafia.

name: Piano Man
description: Piano Man was a member of the Port Mafia's Flags who was responsible for crafting supernotes. The closest to the position of Mafia executive during his time, he was also the founder and de facto leader of the Flags.

name: Ryūnosuke Akutagawa
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Ryūnosuke Akutagawa is a feared Port Mafia fighter whose ability transforms his coat into the destructive beast Rashōmon. Ruthless in battle and desperate for Dazai's recognition, he sees Atsushi as both a rival and an obstacle to proving his worth.

name: Ichiyō Higuchi
description: Ichiyō Higuchi is a Port Mafia member who frequently works alongside Akutagawa. Though she lacks a known ability, she is skilled with firearms and remains fiercely loyal to him despite his cold treatment of her.

name: Ryūrō Hirotsu
description: Ryūrō Hirotsu is the veteran commander of the Port Mafia's Black Lizard unit. Courteous and experienced, he represents the organization's old guard and commands respect through both his composure and his powerful repulsion ability.

name: Gin Akutagawa
description: Gin Akutagawa is a silent and highly skilled assassin who serves as a battalion leader in the Port Mafia's Black Lizard. Beneath her intimidating work persona, she is Ryūnosuke Akutagawa's younger sister and shows a far more ordinary side away from the Mafia.

name: Michizō Tachihara
description: Michizō Tachihara is a metal-manipulating ability user who lived as both a Port Mafia officer and an undercover member of the Hunting Dogs. His divided loyalties force him to question whether his true place lies with his original mission or the people he came to regard as comrades.

name: Elise
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Elise is the manifestation of Ōgai Mori's ability, Vita Sexualis, and his constant companion. Childlike, headstrong, and unpredictable, she often acts according to her own whims while remaining intrinsically linked to Mori, accompanying him in both everyday life and the affairs of the Port Mafia.

name: Karma
description: Karma was a young subordinate forced to serve the Port Mafia executive Ace. Despite the cruelty surrounding him, he retained a hopeful nature and dreamed of escaping the life in which he had been trapped.

name: Kyūsaku Yumeno
description: Kyūsaku Yumeno, commonly called Q, is a dangerous child ability user kept under strict confinement by the Port Mafia. Their ability, Dogra Magra, causes terrifying hallucinations in anyone who harms them, making Q both a victim and a weapon of the organization.

name: Motojirō Kajii
description: Motojirō Kajii is an eccentric Port Mafia bomber who approaches destruction with the enthusiasm of a scientist conducting an experiment. His obsession with lemons extends to both his explosives and his ability to survive lemon-shaped bombs unharmed.

name: Sakunosuke Oda
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Sakunosuke Oda was a low-ranking Port Mafia member who refused to kill and dreamed of becoming a novelist. Quiet, compassionate, and deeply important to Dazai, he cared for a group of orphans and tried to live according to the belief that people can choose a better path.

name: Kazuma Utagawa
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Kazuma Utagawa is a mafioso who had been killed during the Dragon's Head Conflict. He was originally an assassin for an enemy syndicate that became a Mafia subsidiary when they were nearly wiped out. Utagawa is survived by his wife and kids, who do not know of his life as an assassin nor his association with the Mafia.

name: Kurehito Umeki
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Kurehito Umeki is a mafioso who had been killed during the Dragon's Head Conflict. He was a former military police officer who was stigmatized and kicked out of the force for allegedly killing his colleague. He joined the Mafia soon after and proved to be a skilled leader in battle.

name: Miroku Ishige
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Miroku Ishige is a mafioso who had been killed during the Dragon's Head Conflict. Miroku was a former sex worker who had been caring for her sick parents. Her poor eyesight but excellent hearing allowed her to hear the enemies coming before attacking, which played a huge role in the survival of other Mafia members.

name: Shōkichi Saegusa
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Shōkichi Saegusa is a mafioso who had been killed during the Dragon's Head Conflict. Nothing is known about his personality except that according to Ango, he had a way of calming situations down and was apparently loved by the shop owners in the turf.

name: Port Mafia's Previous Boss
japaneseName: ポートマフィアの先代首領
description: He was the unnamed previous boss whom Ōgai Mori succeeded in the Port Mafia eight years ago. During his years, Yokohama had became a violent city. Eventually, he fell to sickness and got bedridden. Later on, he was killed by Mori.

name: Santōka Taneda
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Santōka Taneda is the director of the Special Division for Unusual Powers, the government agency responsible for ability-related affairs. Relaxed in manner but politically perceptive, he often works behind the scenes to preserve the balance among Yokohama's major organizations.

name: Ango Sakaguchi
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Ango Sakaguchi is an intelligence officer in the Special Division for Unusual Powers whose ability reads memories left within objects. Formerly an undercover agent inside the Port Mafia and Mimic, he carries lasting guilt over the betrayals and losses of the Dark Era.

name: Mizuki Tsujimura
lightNovelDebut: Gaiden: Ayatsuji Yukito VS. Kyōgoku Natsuhiko
description: Mizuki Tsujimura is a government agent assigned to supervise the detective Yukito Ayatsuji. Earnest and determined, she struggles to control the inherited ability Yesterday's Shadow Tag while trying to prove herself within the Special Division.

name: Yachiyo Murakoso
description: Yachiyo Murakoso is a government agent affiliated with the Special Division for Unusual Powers. She works in intelligence and operational support during the organization's investigations into ability-related threats.

name: Takuichi Aoki
description: Takuichi Aoki is an agent of the Special Division for Unusual Powers. He assists with intelligence work and government operations involving dangerous ability users.

name: Mizuki Tsujimura (Mother)
lightNovelDebut: Gaiden: Ayatsuji Yukito VS. Kyōgoku Natsuhiko
description: Mizuki Tsujimura's mother is a senior member of the Special Division and the original user of Yesterday's Shadow Tag. Her history as an ability user and government official strongly shapes Mizuki's career and her complicated relationship with her own power.

name: Asukai
lightNovelDebut: Gaiden: Ayatsuji Yukito VS. Kyōgoku Natsuhiko
description: Asukai is a Metropolitan Police inspector involved in the events surrounding Yukito Ayatsuji and the Special Division. Serious and observant, he approaches unusual cases with the discipline of an experienced investigator.

name: Jun Mitamura
lightNovelDebut: The Untold Origins of the Detective Agency
description: Jun Mitamura was a police officer secretly connected to the criminal organization V. His respectable public position concealed his involvement in the conspiracy surrounding the early history of the Armed Detective Agency.

name: Minoura
description: Minoura is a senior police officer who initially views ability users and private detectives with skepticism. After witnessing Ranpo's extraordinary deductions, he becomes one of the Agency's recurring contacts within the police.

name: Sugimoto
description: Sugimoto is a police officer involved in the investigation of Yamagiwa's murder. His role in the case places him at the center of one of Ranpo Edogawa's earliest demonstrations of his deductive skill.

name: Yamagiwa
description: Yamagiwa was a police officer whose murder became the subject of an investigation involving Ranpo Edogawa. The truth surrounding her death exposed deception within the police and helped establish Ranpo's reputation as a detective.

name: Tonan
description: Tonan is the Vice Minister of Justice and a political opponent of the Armed Detective Agency. Motivated by resentment toward the Agency and Fukuzawa, he uses his authority to support efforts aimed at bringing the organization down.

name: Sakashita
lightNovelDebut: Gaiden: Ayatsuji Yukito VS. Kyōgoku Natsuhiko
description: Sakashita is a deputy director within the Ministry of Justice who appears in the conflict surrounding Yukito Ayatsuji. His position connects him to the government's attempts to manage dangerous ability users and politically sensitive investigations.

name: Francis Scott Key Fitzgerald
japaneseName: フランシス・スコット・キー・フィッツジェラルド
description: Francis Scott Key Fitzgerald is the wealthy and charismatic leader of the Guild, whose ability converts money spent into physical power. Driven by his devotion to his family and absolute confidence in his ambitions, he is willing to risk an entire fortune to achieve his goals.

name: Edgar Allan Poe
japaneseName: エドガー・アラン・ポオ
description: Edgar Allan Poe is a Guild architect and mystery writer whose ability pulls readers into the worlds of his novels. Shy and intensely competitive, he considers Ranpo his greatest rival while gradually becoming one of the detective's most valuable allies.

name: Herman Melville
description: Herman Melville is the former leader of the Guild and the user of Moby Dick, a massive flying white whale. Elderly and dignified, he respects Fitzgerald's leadership while retaining the experience and perspective of the organization's previous generation.

name: Howard Phillips Lovecraft
japaneseName: ハワード・フィリップス・ラヴクラフト
description: Howard Phillips Lovecraft is an enigmatic being who worked with the Guild despite showing little interest in ordinary human concerns. His monstrous true form and extraordinary durability suggest that he is something far stranger than a conventional ability user.

name: James L.
description: James L. was a senior secretary of the Guild who handled administrative duties for the organization. His position placed him among Fitzgerald's trusted personnel during the Guild's campaign in Yokohama.

name: John Steinbeck
japaneseName: ジョン・スタインベック
description: John Steinbeck is a Guild ability user who controls plants through The Grapes of Wrath. Motivated largely by the need to support his family, he is practical, resilient, and willing to lead the Guild's remaining forces after Fitzgerald's fall.

name: Lucy Maud Montgomery
japaneseName: ルーシー・モード・モンゴメリ
description: Lucy Maud Montgomery is a former Guild member whose ability creates the sealed alternate space known as Anne's Room. Having also grown up in an orphanage, she forms a strong connection with Atsushi and later helps him and the Agency despite her guarded personality.

name: Louisa May Alcott
japaneseName: ルイーザ・メイ・オルコット
description: Louisa May Alcott is a quiet Guild strategist whose ability allows her to slow the passage of time while she thinks in private. Though extremely shy in public, her careful plans and devotion to Fitzgerald make her one of the Guild's most important minds.

name: Margaret Mitchell
japaneseName: マーガレット・ミッチェル
description: Margaret Mitchell is a proud Guild ability user who joined the organization to restore her family's lost status. Beneath her refined and confident manner, she is determined to survive hardship and protect the future she hopes to reclaim.

name: Mark Twain
description: Mark Twain is an energetic Guild sharpshooter whose ability manifests the tiny companions Huck Finn and Tom Sawyer. Confident and adventurous, he treats dangerous missions with a casual enthusiasm that matches his exceptional aim.

name: Nathaniel Hawthorne
japaneseName: ナサニエル・ホーソーン
description: Nathaniel Hawthorne is a deeply religious ability user whose blood can be shaped into weapons and scripture. Once a member of the Guild, he later becomes an assassin serving Fyodor after his mind and devotion are manipulated.

name: Fyodor Dostoevsky
japaneseName: フョードル・ドストエフスキー

occupations.role: Rats in the House of the Dead leader

description: Fyodor Dostoevsky is the calculating leader of the Rats in the House of the Dead and one of the founders of the Decay of the Angel. Viewing abilities as a stain upon humanity, he manipulates people and entire organizations through elaborate schemes designed to create a world without ability users.

name: Alexander Pushkin
japaneseName: アレクサンドル・プシュキン

occupations.role: Rats in the House of the Dead member

description: Alexander Pushkin is a member of the Rats in the House of the Dead whose ability spreads a lethal infectious disease between targets. Cowardly and self-serving, he relies on his power and his allies rather than confronting opponents directly.

name: Ivan Goncharov
japaneseName: イバン・ゴンチャロフ

occupations.role: Rats in the House of the Dead member

description: Ivan Goncharov is a devoted follower of Fyodor whose ability allows him to manipulate stone and earth. After Fyodor alters his mind, Ivan displays absolute loyalty and treats his service as a source of perfect happiness.

name: Mushitarō Oguri

occupations.role: Rats in the House of the Dead member

description: Mushitarō Oguri is an ability user whose Perfect Crime can erase evidence connected to a murder. Theatrical, proud, and hostile toward detectives, he hides deep grief and loyalty beneath his dramatic behavior.

name: Dame Agatha Christie
japaneseName: デイム・アガサ・クリスティ

occupations.role: Order of the Clock Tower Knight Commander

description: Dame Agatha Christie is the Knight Commander of the Order of the Clock Tower and one of Europe's most influential ability users. Elegant and politically powerful, she operates on an international scale and regards Yokohama's conflicts as part of a much larger struggle.

name: Ōchi Fukuchi
description: Ōchi Fukuchi is a celebrated war hero, captain of the Hunting Dogs, and secret leader of the Decay of the Angel. Traumatized by the horrors of war, he uses his fame, military power, and time-amplifying ability to pursue a radical plan he believes will end future conflict.

name: Bram Stoker
dislikes: the smell of roses and horseshoes
description: Bram Stoker is an ancient ability user whose power can transform people into vampire-like creatures and spread across enormous distances. Formerly controlled by Fukuchi as a weapon, he is weary, sarcastic, and far more compassionate than his frightening reputation suggests.

name: Nikolai Gogol
description: Nikolai Gogol is a flamboyant member of the Decay of the Angel whose ability connects distant spaces through his overcoat. Obsessed with absolute freedom, he behaves like a theatrical trickster while testing whether he can escape every bond, including his attachment to Fyodor.

name: Sigma
dislikes: people who seek to use him
description: Sigma is the manager of the Sky Casino and a former member of the Decay of the Angel. Created from the Book with no past or true home, he desperately protects the casino and searches for a place where he can belong.

name: Teruko Ōkura
description: Teruko Ōkura is the vice-captain of the Hunting Dogs and a fierce supporter of Fukuchi. Her ability lets her alter age, while her unpredictable demeanor shifts between childish playfulness and ruthless military authority.

name: Saigiku Jōno
description: Saigiku Jōno is a blind Hunting Dogs officer whose heightened senses let him detect minute physical reactions and emotional changes. Cruel and provocative during interrogations, he nevertheless follows a personal sense of justice that can place him at odds with corrupt authority.

name: Tetchō Suehiro
likes: combining similar-colored food and eating them
description: Tetchō Suehiro is a Hunting Dogs officer renowned for his swordsmanship and unwavering devotion to justice. Extremely serious and literal-minded, he balances his intimidating combat ability with bizarre food habits and a strong concern for his comrades.

name: Shunzen Tachihara
description: Shunzen Tachihara was a soldier in the 356th Infantry Division and the older brother of Michizō Tachihara. His death during Yosano's service as a wartime surgeon left a lasting impact on both her and his family.

name: Buichirō Shirase
description: Buichirō Shirase is a former member of the Sheep who resented Chūya's power while depending on him for protection. Ambitious and insecure, he later tries to build a new life as the leader of the Stray Sheep.

name: Yuan
description: Yuan is a member of the Sheep who grew up alongside Chūya and the other youths of Suribachi City. She supports the group's efforts to survive independently but becomes involved in the betrayal that drives Chūya away.

name: André Gide
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: André Gide was the commander of Mimic, a group of abandoned soldiers seeking a meaningful death. His ability allowed him to see several seconds into the future, making him the natural counterpart and final opponent of Sakunosuke Oda.

name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
japaneseName: ヨハン・ヴォルフガング・フォン・ゲーテ
description: Johann was called to war along with a group of other notable ability users, which became known as the Transcendents. Goethe and two of the others, Shakespeare and Hugo, clashed, which resulted in an allegedly unprecedented number of casualties and vast damage.

name: Victor Hugo
description: Hugo was called to war along with a group of other notable ability users, which became known as the Transcendents. Hugo and two of the others, Shakespeare and Goethe, clashed, which resulted in an allegedly unprecedented number of casualties and vast damage.

name: William Shakespeare
japaneseName: ウィリアム・シェイクスピア
description: Shakespeare was called to war along with a group of other notable ability users, which became known as the Transcendents. Shakespeare and two of the others, Hugo and Goethe, clashed, which resulted in an allegedly unprecedented number of casualties and vast damage.

name: Jules Gabriel Verne
japaneseName: ジュール・ガブリエル・ヴェルヌ
description: Jules Gabriel Verne was one of the Seven Traitors and the ability user connected to Standard Island. His power let him absorb the abilities of those who died on the island, turning him into the central figure of the 55 Minutes incident.

name: Thumbnail
description: Thumbnail is the leader of the criminal group Zoopark. He uses intimidation and organized violence to control his gang and becomes involved in a case investigated by the Armed Detective Agency.

name: T. J. Eckleburg
japaneseName: T. J. エクレブルク
description: T. J. Eckleburg is an engineer employed by Manhasset Security. His technical work supports the company established by Fitzgerald during his attempt to rebuild his influence and fortune.

name: Tom Buchanan
description: Tom Buchanan was the chairman of Manhasset Security before Fitzgerald took control of the company. Arrogant and self-interested, he underestimated Fitzgerald's determination and was quickly outmaneuvered.

name: S&K Corporation Secretary
japaneseName: S・K商 事 社長秘書
lightNovelDebut: The Untold Origins of the Detective Agency
description: The S&K Corporation secretary was a former public prosecutor who worked closely with the company's president. His connection to the V organization made him part of the conspiracy confronted during the early days of the Armed Detective Agency.

name: Ame-no-Gozen
creator: fyodor-dostoevsky
description: Ame-no-Gozen is a supernatural warrior created through Fyodor's manipulation of Fukuchi's ability and the space-time sword Amenogozen. Existing beyond ordinary human limits, it serves as a devastating instrument in Fyodor's plan.

name: Blond guy
description: The unnamed blond ability user was a criminal encountered during one of Kunikida and Dazai's early cases. His numerical ability allowed him to control objects according to numbers he assigned to them.

name: Criminal Ability User
description: This criminal ability user was a former thief who was held in Meursault and had the ability to stop time

name: Herbert George Wells
japaneseName: ハーバート・ジョージ・ウェルズ
description: Herbert George Wells was a gifted ability user whose Time Machine could manipulate time within a limited area. During the 55 Minutes incident, she used her power and scientific knowledge in an attempt to prevent a catastrophic future.

name: Kyōka's Mother
description: Kyōka's mother was a government assassin and the original user of Demon Snow. Before her death, she transferred the ability to Kyōka in an effort to protect her daughter from the same enemies who targeted their family.

name: Nemo
description: Nemo is the boss of the band of thieves. He is also wanted worldwide for theft by the Scotland Yard Skilled Crime Department.

name: Tatsuhiko Shibusawa
description: Tatsuhiko Shibusawa was an ability collector known as the Draconia and the central antagonist of the DEAD APPLE incident. Fascinated by the crystallized forms of abilities, he sought meaning and self-knowledge by separating gifted people from their powers.

name: Sōseki Natsume
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Sōseki Natsume is a mysterious writer and one of the most influential ability users in Yokohama. As the mentor of both Fukuzawa and Mori, he shaped the city's tripartite balance and often watches events while transformed into a calico cat.

name: Adam Frankenstein
japaneseName: アダム・フランケンシュタイン
description: Adam Frankenstein is an advanced Europole investigator created to pursue the assassin Paul Verlaine. Literal-minded but highly capable, he gradually develops a more human understanding of trust, sacrifice, and friendship while working with Chūya.

name: 幸田 文
description: Aya Kōda is a brave and stubborn young girl who repeatedly becomes involved in conflicts between ability users. Despite having no ability of her own, she risks her life to help others and forms an unexpected friendship with Bram Stoker.

name: Café Uzumaki Store Manager
description: The manager of Café Uzumaki runs the café located beneath the Armed Detective Agency. Patient and dependable, he provides the Agency's members with meals, conversation, and a familiar place to gather between cases.

name: Captain Walston
description: Captain Walston is the captain of the Standard Island. He is the client who asked the Armed Detective Agency to come to the island to capture some thieves.

name: Chiyo
description: Chiyo is a passenger of flight 815S which the Azure Apostle sabotaged by sending an interference signal to the plane.

name: Dr. Mary Wollstonecraft Godwin Shelley
description: Dr. Mary Wollstonecraft Godwin Shelley is a Europole engineer and the creator of Adam Frankenstein. Brilliant and unconventional, she designs advanced artificial life and equips Adam for his mission against Verlaine.

name: Egawa
lightNovelDebut: The Untold Origins of the Detective Agency
description: Egawa is the owner of the theater involved in the case that brought Fukuzawa and Ranpo together. Her establishment becomes the setting for a dangerous plot surrounding the production and its performers.

name: Katsumi
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Katsumi was one of the orphans taken in by Oda.

name: Kōsuke
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Kōsuke was one of the orphans taken in by Oda.

name: Kurahashi
lightNovelDebut: The Untold Origins of the Detective Agency
description: Kurahashi was the playwright of the play The Living World Is a Dream, the Nocturnal Dream is Reality performed at Theatrum Mundi.

name: Kyōka's Father
description: Kyōka's father was a government spy and assassin who worked alongside his wife. When their family was targeted, he fought to protect Kyōka, and his death became part of the tragedy that shaped her childhood.

name: Master Carlyle
description: Master Carlyle is a legendary craftsman and the one who made Kunikida's notebook.

name: Nobuko Sasaki
description: Nobuko Sasaki was a university lecturer and the mastermind known as the Azure Apostle. Intelligent and driven by grief, she pursued a campaign of revenge connected to the ideals and death of the Azure King.

name: Orphanage Director
description: The orphanage director was the abusive man who raised Atsushi and repeatedly convinced him that he was worthless. Although his methods were cruel and deeply damaging, his actions were partly driven by a twisted belief that harshness would prepare Atsushi to survive.

name: N
description: N, redacted for Nakahara, was a researcher who was in charge of Project Arahabaki and the brother of Murase.

name: Freedom Restaurant Owner
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: He was the unnamed restaurant owner of Freedom Restaurant, the restaurant where Sakunosuke Oda often eats curry.

name: Rokuzō Taguchi
description: Rokuzō Taguchi was an information broker who provided info for the Armed Detective Agency. He was highly proficient with hacking into computers and gathering information.

name: Sakura
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Sakura was one of the orphans taken in by Sakunosuke Oda.

name: Shinji
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Shinji was one of the orphans taken in by Sakunosuke Oda.

name: Shōsaku Katsura
description: Shōsaku Katsura is the bomber who harbors a grudge against Kunikida's ideal.

name: Taxi Driver
description: The Taxi Driver is the culprit behind the disappearances of Yohoma visitors. He is a former stage actor and because he couldn't sell at all, he changed his job and became a taxi driver.

name: Tokio Murakami
lightNovelDebut: The Untold Origins of the Detective Agency
description: Tokio Murakami is the lead actor of the play The Living World Is a Dream, the Nocturnal Dream is Reality performed at Theatrum Mundi.

name: Yokomizo
description: Yokomizo was a mystery writer and the close friend of Mushitarō Oguri. His final request placed Mushitarō at the center of a seemingly perfect murder and became the emotional foundation of Mushitarō's hostility toward detectives.

name: Yū
lightNovelDebut: Osamu Dazai and the Dark Era
description: Yū was one of the orphans taken in by Oda.

name: Zadkiel Alamta
japaneseName: ザドキエル・アラムタ
description: Zadkiel Alamta is a bomb purveyor for a Middle Eastern terrorist organization. He's been behind multiple large-scale bombings around the world in the past. The Public Security Intelligence Angecy has been keeping trying to capture him ever since he arrived in Japan. He is extremely good with bombs. He specializes in railroad car bombs that contain a mixture of aluminum powder in slurry explosives.

name: Pan
